---
title: "UMAP Embedding (Lite)"
subtitle: "Single configuration (nn=10, md=0.5), seed-averaged, thresholds 7 & 8"
---

## Overview

Compute 6-component UMAP embeddings for thresholds 7 and 8 using a single parameter configuration (n_neighbors=10, min_dist=0.5) with 5 random seeds, then average embeddings across seeds per subject. This combination was selected as the best Path2D DPS configuration by a parameter sweep; the sweep itself is not part of this release.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(umap, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Constants

```{r}
#| label: constants

THRESHOLDS <- c(7, 8)
N_COMPONENTS <- 6
N_NEIGHBORS <- 10
MIN_DIST <- 0.5
RANDOM_SEEDS <- c(123, 223, 323, 423, 523)
```

## Load Data

Load adjusted methylation matrices for each threshold.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

meth_data <- THRESHOLDS |>
  set_names(paste0("threshold_", THRESHOLDS)) |>
  map(function(threshold) {
    file_path <- here(glue(
      "data/collaborator_only/adjusted_meth/adjusted_methylation_scaled_nlog10p_gte_{threshold}.rds"
    ))
    data <- read_rds(file_path)

    methylation_matrix <- data |>
      select(starts_with("cg")) |>
      as.matrix()

    scaled_matrix <- scale(methylation_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

    list(
      scaled_matrix = scaled_matrix,
      subject_ids = data$subject_id,
      trajectory_labels = data$demcat,
      n_subjects = nrow(scaled_matrix),
      n_cpg_sites = ncol(scaled_matrix)
    )
  })

walk2(names(meth_data), meth_data, \(nm, ds) {
  message(glue("{nm}: {ds$n_subjects} subjects, {ds$n_cpg_sites} CpGs"))
})
```

## Run UMAP

Run UMAP for each threshold x seed combination (10 total), then average across seeds.

```{r}
#| label: run-umap

run_umap_single <- function(data_matrix, seed) {
  # uwot (not the umap package): its spectral init is seeded deterministically, so
  # results are bit-reproducible run-to-run. n_sgd_threads = 1 is REQUIRED for
  # reproducibility (multi-threaded SGD is non-deterministic). Returns the layout matrix.
  uwot::umap(
    data_matrix,
    n_neighbors   = N_NEIGHBORS,
    min_dist      = MIN_DIST,
    n_components  = N_COMPONENTS,
    init          = "spectral",
    seed          = seed,
    n_threads     = 1,
    n_sgd_threads = 1,
    verbose       = FALSE
  )
}

fs::dir_create(here("UMAP/lite/output"))

for (threshold in THRESHOLDS) {
  ds <- meth_data[[glue("threshold_{threshold}")]]
  message(glue("Processing threshold {threshold}..."))
  tictoc::tic(glue("Threshold {threshold}"))

  # Run UMAP with each seed
  embeddings <- map(RANDOM_SEEDS, \(seed) {
    message(glue("  Seed {seed}..."))
    run_umap_single(ds$scaled_matrix, seed)
  })

  # Average across seeds
  avg_embedding <- Reduce("+", embeddings) / length(embeddings)

  # Create output tibble
  embedding_tbl <- tibble(
    subject_id = ds$subject_ids,
    demcat = ds$trajectory_labels
  ) |>
    bind_cols(
      as_tibble(avg_embedding, .name_repair = ~paste0("umap_", 1:N_COMPONENTS))
    )

  # Save
  write_rds(
    embedding_tbl,
    here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/embedding_threshold_{threshold}.rds"))
  )

  tictoc::toc()
  message(glue("  Saved: embedding_threshold_{threshold}.rds ({nrow(embedding_tbl)} subjects)"))
}
```

## Verify Outputs

```{r}
#| label: verify

walk(THRESHOLDS, \(threshold) {
  emb <- read_rds(here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/embedding_threshold_{threshold}.rds")))
  message(glue("Threshold {threshold}: {nrow(emb)} rows, {ncol(emb)} cols"))
  message(glue("  Demcat levels: {paste(unique(emb$demcat), collapse = ', ')}"))
})
```
